title_en: Information Session for Fall 2027 Outbound Exchange Student Recruitment
summary: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in studying at a foreign university as outbound exchange students are invited to an information session on the Fall 2027 exchange semester. The session will be held on Friday, 30 October 2026, at 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30, in the first-floor Seminar Room of Building 152 (CJ International Center). Both sessions cover the same content.
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in being sent to a foreign university as exchange students. Attendance is encouraged and is not stated to be mandatory.

dates.what: Information session, afternoon session (same content as the morning session)

conditions: The same content is presented at both the morning and the afternoon session.
steps: Read the detailed information on the Office of International Affairs website: https://oga.snu.ac.kr/outgoing_notice-board/?mod=document&uid=3125
Attend either the morning (10:00–11:30) or the afternoon (14:00–15:30) session on Friday, 30 October 2026, in the Seminar Room, 1st floor, Building 152 (CJ International Center).
For questions, contact the staff member at the Office of International Affairs; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Information Session for Fall 2027 Outbound Exchange Student Recruitment

An information session on the recruitment of outbound exchange students for the Fall 2027 semester (2027학년도 2학기) will be held. Interested students are encouraged to attend.

1. Date and time: Friday, 30 October 2026, 10:00–11:30 (morning) / 14:00–15:30 (afternoon)
* The same content will be presented twice, once in the morning and once in the afternoon.

2. Venue: Seminar Room, 1st floor, Building 152 (CJ International Center)

3. Main content: General information on the outbound exchange semester

4. Intended audience: Undergraduate and graduate students interested in being sent to a foreign university

5. Details: https://oga.snu.ac.kr/outgoing_notice-board/?mod=document&uid=3125

6. Inquiries: A staff member of the Office of International Affairs (국제처); the contact details are given in the original notice.
